svg.title: Austin: conditional historical room for additional net costs, not a current appraisal
svg.desc: March 31, 2025 model anchor, assembled from amended historical disclosures inspected September 29, 2026. April 2025–2029 minimum fees, first-quarter expense calibration, 10% assumed return, year-end timing. Flat expense leaves $10.427 million present-value budget; 3% annual expense growth leaves $5.695 million; 6% leaves $0.690 million; 6% plus $1 million a year net cash-cost correction leaves minus $2.960 million. Expense is not verified cash cost. No terminal sale or undated later fees. Positive budget is not equity cash or appraised value; negative is not a default or shutdown instruction.
